actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H3738-3740)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by voice vote.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 2635.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3738-3740)
Mr. Baumgartner moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Ordered to be Reported by Voice Vote.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects Uyghurs and other minority groups in the XUAR and diaspora, State Department Foreign Service officers, human rights advocates, and international diplomats.
dimensions.evidence: prioritize policies, programs, and projects to support the Uyghurs and members of other ethnic and religious minority groups in the XUAR

dimensions.assessment: Directs diplomatic coordination, reporting, language training staffing, and funding for human rights advocates to speak at international forums.
dimensions.evidence: Of the amounts authorized to be appropriated for the United States Speaker Program... $250,000 for each of fiscal years 2025, 2026, and 2027 is authorized to be made available

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the use of $250,000 per year from existing authorized funds (no additional funds authorized) for speaker programs.
dimensions.evidence: No additional funds are authorized to carry out the requirements of this Act. Such requirements shall be carried out using amounts otherwise authorized.

dimensions.assessment: Broad policy directives covering State Department priorities, diplomatic engagement, language training, UN strategies, and multi-agency reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of State, as appropriate, shall-- (1) prioritize policies, programs, and projects to support the Uyghurs... (4) lead coordination efforts for the release of political prisoners

dimensions.assessment: Section 4 terminates 5 years after enactment, while speaker program funding covers fiscal years 2025, 2026, and 2027, and language training mandates continue.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall terminate on the date that is 5 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific number of Foreign Service officers who will complete Uyghur language training.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the State Department to prioritize policies supporting Uyghur human rights, coordinate release efforts for political prisoners, provide language training, make $250,000 annually available for human rights advocates under an existing speaker program, and submit reports to Congress.
